_comment: Devices the panel manages, keyed by MAC address. Only devices you have annotated live here; anything else found by a LAN scan is runtime state shown in the panel and never written to disk. SSH credentials unlock Wake-on-LAN, the terminal, remote-desktop deployment, and neutrino_client installation.

aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.name: work-laptop
aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff._comment_ssh: Written by the panel, not by hand. auth is 'key' or 'password'. For key auth, key_id references a key in the Credentials tab (config/credentials/ssh_keys/); the material is never stored here.

ssh._comment_sudo: sudo_password is needed for one-click installs (ToDesk, AnyDesk, neutrino_client). Leave null if the account has passwordless sudo.

aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff._comment_client: Filled in automatically once neutrino_client is installed on the device.
